claims.value: Weatherhaven is a direct defence supplier of deployable military shelter and command-and-control infrastructure, with a documented Canadian Army Headquarters Shelter System acquisition and in-service-support role alongside dual-use medical and emergency applications.

claims.value: Navamar is a direct naval supplier and marine-services company whose Montréal operation built and delivered the Royal Canadian Navy's four sea-to-shore connector systems for the Joint Support Ship project.

source.locator: March 2024 and August 2019 sea-to-shore connector updates

claims.analystNote: Supports only the bounded refresh. The public record does not establish current follow-on production, support scope after final delivery, fleet availability, connector modification plans, production capacity, or readiness for a new naval requirement.

claims.value: Vard Marine is a Canadian naval-architecture and marine-engineering supplier with federal naval-design work and a defence portfolio that includes the Team Vigilance multi-mission patrol-vessel concept; Vigilance remains an industry proposal rather than a reported Royal Canadian Navy procurement.
claims.analystNote: Supports only the bounded refresh. The public sources do not establish an RCN selection of Vigilance, current program requirements, configuration baseline, cost, schedule, Canadian workshare, or which Team Vigilance suppliers would be retained in an eventual competition.

claims.value: DEW Engineering is a direct Canadian defence supplier of military-grade integrated shelters and vehicle-related systems, supported by a Canadian Forces MSVS delivery history and a separately recorded CAF deployable-shelter contract.
claims.analystNote: Supports only the bounded refresh. The cited contract expired in March 2025 and public sources do not establish current option status, active order volume, production capacity, delivery lead time, exact qualification baselines, or availability for a new requirement.
